title: Check your AI question usage
summary: AI settings shows how many questions this period included, used and topped up, and who asked them.

steps.text: Open {settings} from the AI page's settings link, or from Settings directly. It shows how many questions are included, used and topped up this period.
Owners and admins who can manage users also see a table of how many questions each person asked this month, so usage can be reviewed without reading every conversation.
